channel.title: Muhammad Awais — AI Automation Case Studies
channel.description: Documented n8n, Make.com and AI automation case studies by Muhammad Awais, AI Automation Engineer.

item.title: Automated Business KPI Analysis & Growth Insights
item.description: Automated n8n reporting system that syncs business metrics to Google Sheets, flags revenue anomalies with AI and sends executive summaries on schedule.

item.title: Brand-Governed Content Engine with Deterministic Critic Loop
item.description: Actor-Critic content compiler with JSON schema enforcement: turns long-form audio into 30+ compliant social posts daily with 100% brand voice alignment.

item.title: Hierarchical L1/L2 Customer Support Orchestrator
item.description: Supervisor-Worker multi-agent swarm in LangGraph that semantically coordinates Stripe billing, Linear/GitHub APIs, and Pinecone vector RAG.

item.title: Autonomous CI/CD Code Reviewer & Refactoring Harness
item.description: Evaluator-Optimizer agent harness testing git diffs in Docker sandboxes and committing verified refactor patches directly via GitHub MCP.

item.title: Local BI Data Analyst via Custom Model Context Protocol (MCP)
item.description: Custom Python Model Context Protocol (MCP) server with self-correcting ReAct SQL loops, read-only PostgreSQL sandboxing, and zero PII data leakage.

item.title: Autonomous Proposal Swarm with Human-in-the-Loop Governance
item.description: LangGraph multi-agent state machine with human-in-the-loop interrupts that turns raw discovery audio into executive-ready proposals in 3 minutes.

item.title: Recreate Instagram Reels on Demand with Gemini & MiniMax
item.description: Production n8n workflow that downloads Instagram Reels, extracts prompts with Gemini 2.0 Flash and generates fresh AI videos with MiniMax on Replicate.

item.title: Voice AI Appointment Booking with ElevenLabs & Cal.com
item.description: Production voice AI appointment agent: ElevenLabs calls an n8n webhook to check live Cal.com calendar slots and books verified meetings over the phone.

item.title: AI Lead Meeting Scheduling with Zoho CRM, Google Calendar & Gemini
item.description: Automated n8n scheduling system turning Zoho CRM leads into confirmed calendar bookings with timezone intelligence, Zoom links and Gemini invite copy.

item.title: Dynamic HubSpot Lead Routing with GPT-4 & Airtable
item.description: n8n AI lead qualification system that scores incoming HubSpot contacts using GPT-4, matches team availability in Airtable and assigns reps in real time.

item.title: Automated LinkedIn Job Search Automation with OpenAI & Telegram Alerts
item.description: n8n automation that scrapes LinkedIn openings daily, matches candidate profiles using OpenAI, drafts custom proposals and dispatches alerts to Telegram.

item.title: Instagram Reels Outlier Detection & Telegram Reporting
item.description: n8n social analytics system monitoring 50+ competitor accounts, scoring video views against account medians and sending viral outlier alerts to Telegram.

item.title: AI Lead Qualification for Real Estate Buyer Inquiries
item.description: AI lead scoring system that enriches buyer inquiries with AI, scores buying intent from 0–100, routes hot leads to agents and logs records to Airtable.

item.title: End-to-End Client Intake & Onboarding Automation
item.description: End-to-end client onboarding automation chaining intake forms, calendar booking, invoice generation and Notion workspace provisioning seamlessly.

item.title: Automated Slack Reporting Pipeline with Apify and n8n
item.description: Client build: Apify scrapes industry feeds daily, then n8n and Make.com post actionable Slack summaries to the team, saving 10+ hours a week.

item.title: Automated Offer Letter & Response Tracking System
item.description: n8n HR document workflow that compiles PDF offer letters from Google Docs, tracks one-click recipient replies and syncs status updates to Google Sheets.

item.title: AI-Powered Review Management System
item.description: n8n reputation management workflow that captures Google Maps reviews, alerts operations on low ratings and auto-generates contextual reply drafts.

item.title: Smart WhatsApp AI Assistant with a Google Docs Knowledge Base
item.description: 24/7 WhatsApp AI customer agent built with n8n that grounds conversations in live Google Docs, maintains per-contact memory and escalates complex queries.

item.title: Advanced Multi-Query RAG System with Supabase & OpenAI
item.description: n8n RAG agent on Supabase pgvector and OpenAI: splits questions into 1-5 sub-queries, keeps chunks above 0.4 similarity and answers only from your docs.

item.title: AI Customer Support Triage System
item.description: Multi-channel support triage system that classifies incoming customer tickets with LLMs by urgency and sentiment, notifies Slack and drafts responses.

item.title: AI-Powered Email Labeling Agent for Inbox Management
item.description: Gmail AI agent built with n8n that reads incoming client inquiries, classifies urgency and applies smart labels automatically to keep the inbox organized.

item.title: AI-Powered YouTube Publishing Automation
item.description: Automated content pipeline that ingests raw video files from Google Drive, generates optimized YouTube titles and tags with AI and schedules publishing.

item.title: Automated Lead Reply & Follow-Up System
item.description: Two-way CRM integration linking GoHighLevel and ClickUp: auto-assigns sales follow-ups, syncs reply sentiment and eliminates lead response delays.

item.title: Real Estate Lead Generation & Property Monitoring
item.description: Make.com & BrowserAct web automation tracking real estate listings against custom criteria with instant multi-channel push to Telegram and CRM systems.
